title: tangles
excerpt: if you were a person, i'd beat you up.
body:
if you were a person, i'd beat you up.
not in a cruel way or anything but as an
expression of my frustration with you, you
oafish pathetic slob, always
stubbing your toes, looping incessantly in
your own forgetfulness. one day you learned
that walking the hypotenuse would save you
extra steps and a ninety degree turn. now
your discordant feet plague you with every
step you take, splitting
you like a zipper as they choose their own
diagonals to pursue. it's a wonder you get
anything done when you're spilling sugar all
over yourself and tripping over the cables
you plugged in haphazardly.

you stupid,
big lipped fool.
one day i'll pull those bedhead curls right off
your steaming cranium.
